title: Trust boundaries and capacity need explicit answers

elements.alt: New illustrative Locations Canvas for the partner payment example

items: Identify the caller and permitted payment objects.
Agree exposed endpoints, network paths and data locations.
Measure normal and peak demand before setting limits.
Test retries, delays and recovery without duplicate processing.
